<action type="say">
I’m not able to initiate a carrier intercept or attach instructions to this specific shipment from here, and I also can’t pre‑set an automatic refund. Those actions have to be handled either by the carrier or by customer support once the package is in their system.

Here’s the best way to handle it:

1. If you’re home when it’s delivered:
   - Tell the driver you’re refusing the package and do not sign for or accept it.
   - The carrier will mark it as “refused/return to sender” and route it back.
   - Once tracking shows it has been returned to the sender and processed, you should receive a refund; if you don’t see one, contact support with order ID ODR-117890 so they can push it through.

2. If it gets left at your door/mailroom/locker:
   - You won’t be able to refuse at the door in that case.
   - Instead, once it’s marked as delivered, start a standard return using the order ID ODR-117890 (via the returns portal or by contacting support).
   - After the return is received and processed, your refund will be issued.

So while I can’t “set it up” in the system, refusing the package at the door is exactly what you described and should result in the order being returned and refunded once it’s processed as a return-to-sender.</action>
